sourceText: “One word,” said the lawyer. “Carew was my client, but so are you, and I want to know what I am doing. You have not been mad enough to hide this fellow?”

attempts.label: primary

TRANSLATION: “toki wan taso,” jan pi sona lawa li toki. “tenpo pini la jan Kewi li jan pi pana mani tawa mi. sina kin li sama. mi wile sona e pali mi. sina nasa mute ala la, sina len ala e jan ni, anu seme?”
